title: CD sales are booming as physical media continues its resurgence
summary: According to the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA), CD sales exploded in the first half of 2026. A new report from the organization says 17.5 million CDs were sold in the first six months of the year, up from just 12 million during the same period in 2025. That's a jump of 45.7 percent, […]
llm_summary: In the first half of 2026, CD sales surged to 17.5 million units—up 45.7 % from the same period a year earlier, according to the RIAA. The rebound highlights a broader revival of physical media, as collectors and audiophiles increasingly favor tangible formats over streaming. This growth signals that, despite the dominance of digital music, physical releases still hold a profitable niche in today’s tech‑savvy
